description: This file defines the MonkeyThrottleEvent class used in Android's Monkey testing framework. It models a throttle (delay) event that causes the test to sleep for a specified duration.

classes.name: MonkeyThrottleEvent
classes.description: A class representing a throttle event in Android's Monkey testing framework, used to introduce delays between events.

methods.name: MonkeyThrottleEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the throttle duration.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Performs the throttle delay by sleeping for the specified duration and logging if verbose level is high.
